During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''training squadron''' was based aboard the [[Victorious (capital ship)|''Victorious'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Qeimet fleet]]. During the [[Assault of U'Dray|assault]] on [[U'Dray]] during the [[Hook Nebula campaign]], pilots from the training squadron were transferred to the [[Scimitar assault wing]] due to combat losses suffered by the unit.
